company_description:
Halden Pay is a fintech serving exporters with business accounts, foreign-exchange risk management and trade finance. Its work spans financial services and payments, with engineering teams focused on payments, risk, data platforms and client experience.

The company’s stated values are **Together, Ownership and Pace**: sharing information and supporting colleagues across teams; taking responsibility, fixing problems and learning from them; and reducing unnecessary complexity to move quickly for clients. Halden Pay highlights clear career paths, an annual learning budget and mentoring in every department.

The working environment is generally described as collaborative, with friendly colleagues and a commercially driven culture. Most offices use a hybrid model, with three days a week in the office; team events and regular get-togethers help connect staff across roughly 40 offices. Employee feedback is mixed: culture ratings are around 3.3–3.4 out of 5, and some reviewers say onboarding and training vary between teams.

work_context.location_limits: Lisbon, Portugal; 3 days per week in the office. No other country, time-zone, relocation, or right-to-work limits are stated.

results.title: Halden Pay | Careers
results.content:
Growth and recognition
We offer clear career paths, a yearly learning budget and a mentoring programme in every department.
Our values: Together, Ownership, Pace
Together - we share context openly and help each other across teams.
Ownership - when something goes wrong we own it, fix it and learn from it.
Pace - we cut unnecessary complexity so we can move quickly for our clients.
How we work
Most of our offices work hybrid: people spend three days a week together in the office and the rest wherever suits them. Our engineering teams are organised in product areas: payments, risk, data platform and client experience. Team events and regular get-togethers are part of how we build connections across about 40 offices.
